verdict.rationale: The evidence describes gstack as a bundle of 23 tools installed through a git-clone-and-copy model, with dev mode symlinking the whole repo into .claude/skills/. Nothing documents installing only chosen skills from the collection. The compressed agents digest for hosts "without a full skill install" is an alternative rules file, not selective skill installation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle
